description: Shared examples of the gateway API JSON envelopes (crates/protocol/src/api.rs, packages/protocol/src/gateway-api.ts). Each valid example must parse and serialize back to the same JSON value. Each invalid example must fail to parse as its type.

open_chunk_paths.description: PUT /v1/open/chunks/{batch_id}/{proof_sha256}/{total_bytes}/{chunk_count}/{chunk_index}. The body is the raw chunk bytes. Each valid path must parse to its target and the target must render to the same path. Each invalid path must fail to parse.
